name: Medscape-Like Platform Operators

pain_points: Engagement quality and outcomes proof are weak or slow to produce

fit_logic.proceed: When positioned as proof/insight upgrade or modular format engine
fit_logic.park: If they require full stack replacement

what_proof_means: Sponsor-ready evidence beyond clicks, plus insight to steer editorial and product.
yoke_strengths: As a proof/insight layer, or as a high-engagement format layer they can plug in
Trendlines and longitudinal insight for sponsor packages
yoke_weaknesses: Replacing their entire platform stack. That is rarely the right sell.

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke plugs into large platforms as a proof/insight layer—providing engagement depth and sponsor-ready outcomes beyond clicks.
key_benefits: Plug-in proof/insight layer, not platform replacement
Trendlines for editorial and product decisions
messaging.elevator_pitch: Large platforms have reach but need engagement depth. Yoke plugs in as a proof layer—giving sponsors real outcomes evidence and editorial teams insight beyond clicks.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase sponsor revenue with outcomes proof
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce proof production time and editorial guesswork
